    static URI
    URI.create(String text)
    Parses text as a URI; see the class description.
    URI
    URI.resolve(URI reference)
    Resolves reference against this URI as RFC 3986 section 5.2 does: an absolute reference is returned as it is; a reference with an authority keeps only this URI's scheme; any other takes this URI's scheme and authority, and its path is merged with this URI's and has its . and .. segments removed.
    URI
    URI.resolve(String reference)
